request_payload_digest.question: Найди arXiv-публикацию Attention Is All You Need и кратко опиши по аннотации.

response.answer: Публикация «Attention Is All You Need» (arXiv:1706.03762v7) представляет новую архитектуру нейронной сети — **Transformer**, основанную исключительно на механизмах внимания и не использующую рекуррентные или свёрточные слои. Эта архитектура позволяет значительно улучшить качество машинного перевода и обеспечивает высокую параллелизуемость, что сокращает время обучения. Модель достигает 28.4 BLEU на задаче перевода с английского на немецкий (WMT 2014) и устанавливает новый рекорд — 41.8 BLEU — на задаче перевода с английского на французский, обучаясь всего 3.5 дня на восьми GPU. Авторы также демонстрируют, что Transformer хорошо обобщается на другие задачи, успешно применяя его к синтаксическому разбору английского языка.

bullets: Introduces Tool Attention, a middleware-layer mechanism to reduce the MCP/Tools Tax in LLM agent workflows by 95% (47.3k -> 2.4k tokens per turn)
Proposes dynamic tool gating and lazy schema loading using Intent Schema Overlap scoring, state-aware gating, and a two-phase schema loader
Demonstrates 91% effective context utilization vs. 24% in baseline, reducing key-value cache inflation and reasoning degradation
Generalizes the 'Attention Is All You Need' concept from tokens to tools, targeting scalable agentic systems
Builds on the original Transformer architecture that relies solely on attention, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions
Highlights limitations of self-attention in pre-trained models, suggesting not all attention mechanisms are equally effective
Presents element-wise attention as a low-complexity alternative to dot-product self-attention with comparable performance
Shows self-attention layers are exclusively responsible for retrieval in hybrid SSM-Transformer models
Finds sparsifying attention to 15% of heads maintains near-perfect retrieval and 84% MMLU performance
Identifies strict mechanistic requirements for retrieval: needle token exposure and sufficient context availability
Argues protocol-level efficiency, not context length, is the binding constraint for scalable generative systems

item.title: Attention Is All You Need
item.summary: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks in an encoder-decoder configuration. The best performing models also connect the encoder and decoder through an attention mechanism. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely. Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train. Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles by over 2 BLEU. On the WMT 2014 English-to-French translation task, our model establishes a new single-model state-of-the-art BLEU score of 41.8 after training for 3.5 days on eight GPUs, a small fraction of the training costs of the best models from the literature. We show that the Transformer generalizes well to other tasks by applying it successfully to English constituency parsing both with large and limited training data.
